subject.title: feat(state): R2-backed ledger/v1 + assets blob transport, migration workflow, and opt-in dual-read (phase 3 foundation)

question: Should ClawSweeper approve the R2 ledger/assets transport as the supported phase-3 state migration direction once its live deployment, migration, and security gates are satisfied?
rationale: The patch intentionally adds a new persistent-state transport, operator workflow, and opt-in configuration mode; deciding whether that becomes the supported migration contract requires maintainer ownership beyond ordinary line review.

options.title: Approve the phase-3 direction with gates
options.body: Accept the R2 migration design after the security alert is resolved and live deploy/migrate/hydrate evidence proves the opt-in path and fallback.

options.title: Keep git state as the only supported path
options.body: Decline this migration direction and retain the existing git-backed state lane until a different state architecture is approved.

options.title: Narrow the proposal first
options.body: Request a smaller transport-only or migration-only change before accepting the full Worker, workflow, and hydration contract together.

recommendation.title: Approve the phase-3 direction with gates
recommendation.body: Accept the R2 migration design after the security alert is resolved and live deploy/migrate/hydrate evidence proves the opt-in path and fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The available commit trail shows direct ownership of this proposed phase-3 state migration implementation, although broader current-main ownership could not be confirmed.
